items.body: Today's principal delta: The Section 122 surcharge hard-expired at 12:01 a.m. ET on July 24, 2026, exactly as the statute required, and the administration moved simultaneously — without a single day's gap — to replace it with a new global tariff regime under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974.
